dod_intent_evidence: 2022 Defense Health Program SBIR Phase II ($2.2M, nXcomms) plus site client list naming ONR, NAVAIR, Army Futures Command, Womack Army Medical Center — sbir_abstract and homepage sections.
score_evidence: "nXcomms is a groundbreaking project that adds natural language processing and AI features to simulated patients" → lab_language_intensity
"Advancements in human-machine interfaces, artificial intelligence, wearable sensors... are revolutionizing fields" → lab_language_intensity

"Real-time digital representations incorporating physical, cognitive, emotional, and behavioral data" — detailed product description with zero ATO/RMF/CMMC/DDIL/ITAR language anywhere on site → deployment_awareness_absence
No jobs data in pack → hiring_profile_skew set exactly 10 per rule
Phase II awarded 2022, so period of performance is at or past its end; 6-person team carrying a multi-project portfolio → stage_pressure

blind_spots.blind_spot: Human Digital Twin platform aggregates individual service members' physiological, cognitive, and behavioral data with no mention of the accreditation that data demands
blind_spots.operator_reality: Per-soldier health and performance data is PII/PHI on DoD networks — it forces IL4/IL5 hosting, an RMF ATO, and DHA privacy review before a single medic's twin exists; that authorization timeline, not the AI, decides whether nXcomms fields before the Phase II money runs out
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team background is software/XR/computational biology R&D funded by research grants; the site's compliance vocabulary is zero
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Real-time digital representations incorporating physical, cognitive, emotional, and behavioral data for holistic individual assessment and predictive state monitoring

blind_spots.blind_spot: nXcomms leans on NLP/advanced-AI inference with no stated offline or on-prem architecture
blind_spots.operator_reality: Military medical training happens at field hospitals, aboard ships, and at Role 2 sites where cloud AI endpoints are unreachable — same failure mode as the 30fps crowd-detection case: the architecture assumes connectivity the training environment denies
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The Phase II abstract frames success as demonstrating an 'Intelligent Patient Simulation software architecture,' not running it disconnected at a point of need
blind_spots.evidence_quote: leveraging natural language processing and advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies

blind_spots.blind_spot: XR training hardware sustainment is absent — no training-the-trainer, spares, or GFE story
blind_spots.operator_reality: An XR sim at a MEDCEN or field training site lives or dies on who recharges headsets, reflashes builds, and trains the NCO instructor after the contractor leaves; without a sustainment plan the demo stays a demo and DHA can't transition it
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Grant-funded project cadence rewards deliverable demos; 6 people cannot staff field support and the site never mentions sustainment
blind_spots.evidence_quote: TRIAGE combines confidence-building and skills-enhancement with stress inoculation... through immersive 3D virtual and physical training environments

opener_hook: BioMojo's 2022 Defense Health Program Phase II funds an AI patient simulator whose per-soldier physiological data forces an IL4 ATO on DHA networks — the one word ('RMF') that appears nowhere on biomojo.com.
what_they_do: 6-person NC shop building AI/XR medical-training sims and human digital twins for military health customers on SBIR and research-grant funding.
